open_points.subject: Project revision when a room is added
open_points.text: “A Project ... carry a revision, an ordinal starting at 1 that every accepted change moves by one” and M01 lists “its rooms” among the Project’s facts, but “It does not move by: adding a room”.
open_points.question: Is adding a room a change to the Project that increments its revision and last-changed instant, or is the room relationship outside the revisioned Project facts?
options: Adding a room increments the Project revision and last-changed instant
Adding a room creates only the Room and leaves the Project revision and last-changed instant unchanged
open_points.default_guess: Treat Room as a separately created owned entity and leave the Project revision and last-changed instant unchanged, following the specific action list.

open_points.subject: Project revision and times at anonymisation
open_points.text: “A Project ... carry a revision” and “A Project ... carry the instant they were created and the instant they were last changed” conflict with “An anonymised project is a Project ... revision and every instant are gone”; the list of actions moving the last-changed instant mentions only repeated anonymisation, not the first anonymisation.
open_points.question: Does the first anonymisation increment the Project revision and last-changed instant before those facts are removed, or does anonymisation remove them without such a revision transition?
options: Increment the revision and last-changed instant, then remove both as part of anonymisation
Remove the revision and all Project instants without incrementing them
Retain a terminal revision or last-changed instant on the anonymised Project
open_points.default_guess: Remove the revision and all Project instants without incrementing them, because R0-62/R0-87 explicitly limit the surviving facts.

open_points.subject: Project facts and artifact-pointer ownership
open_points.text: “The facts listed under a model are all its facts”; M01 lists rooms but no artifact pointers, while its lifecycle says an anonymised Project “keeps ... its artifact pointers” and M05 says a pointer is “owned by its Project record”.
open_points.question: Is the Project-to-artifact-pointer collection a fact carried by M01, or are ArtifactPointers independent records that merely reference a Project and survive its anonymisation?
options: M01 carries its artifact-pointer collection as an owned fact
M05 records independently reference project_id; M01 carries no pointer collection
Pointers are embedded in M01 only after anonymisation
open_points.default_guess: Treat ArtifactPointers as independent durable entities referencing project_id, with lifecycle rules that preserve them when the Project is anonymised and remove them when it is deleted whole.

open_points.subject: Project create request facts
open_points.text: The introduction says “the facts a create request supplies are named with it”, but M01 only lists the Project’s carried facts and does not distinguish owner-supplied creation facts from Registry-minted or subsequently created facts.
open_points.question: Exactly which Project facts may or must the create-project action receive: display name, alias, customer_ref, object address, object kind, object characteristics, and/or initial rooms?
options: Require display name and object address; allow alias, customer_ref, object kind and characteristics; create rooms only through add-room
Allow initial rooms as part of project creation as well
Accept only display name and address at creation; add all other optional facts later
open_points.default_guess: Require display name and object address, allow alias, customer_ref, object kind and characteristics, and require rooms to be created through add-room.

open_points.subject: Imported Project display name
open_points.text: The primary import action says the selected projects arrive “each with a new display name and alias when the owner gives them”, while R0-85 says the owner “may give each a new display name and an alias”; R0-82 also says projects imported under a person’s name must be renamed in the import.
open_points.question: Must every imported Project receive a new display name, is a replacement optional except when the source name violates R0-82, or may every source display name be retained?
options: A new display name is required for every imported Project
A new display name is optional, but required when the source name identifies a person or otherwise violates R0-82
A new display name is always optional and the source name may always be retained
open_points.default_guess: Require a new display name for every imported Project, following the primary action’s wording and avoiding retention of legacy personal names.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry identity format
open_points.text: “Every identity Registry mints ... is ... a UUID” conflicts with M09 making the AuditEntry an entity whose identity is “its sequence number, minted by Registry: 1 ... then one more than the last ever written”.
open_points.question: Is an AuditEntry identified solely by its ordinal sequence number, by a Registry-minted UUID, or by both?
options: The sequence number is the AuditEntry identity and is an explicit exception to the UUID rule
Each AuditEntry has a UUID identity and a separate ordering sequence number
The UUID and sequence number together form its identity
open_points.default_guess: Use the sequence number as the AuditEntry identity and amend the UUID rule to make this explicit exception.

open_points.subject: Audit entries for accepted no-op actions
open_points.text: M09 says archiving, anonymising and erasing a customer write entries, while State 0 says archiving an archived project, anonymising an anonymised project and erasing an erased customer return the record unchanged; R0-58 says the log records significant changes of state.
open_points.question: Does an accepted action that makes no state change create an AuditEntry?
options: No; only the first state-changing archive, anonymisation or erasure creates an entry
Yes; every accepted invocation of a listed action creates an entry
Only confirmed no-op actions create entries, recording their confirmation
open_points.default_guess: Create no AuditEntry for an accepted no-op because no significant state change occurred.

open_points.subject: Audit subject for the import
open_points.text: M09 says an audit subject is recorded “by identity only” and names “the migration closure (M10) for the import”, but M10 is a value with no identifier of its own.
open_points.question: What identity-only fact does the import AuditEntry store as its subject?
options: A fixed subject kind meaning the singleton migration closure
The migration closure’s confirmation id
The accepted file digest
The whole embedded MigrationClosure value
open_points.default_guess: Use a fixed singleton subject kind for the migration closure; keep the confirmation id and file digest in their separately defined facts.
